decision_lens: Prioritizes findings where a name contradicts the elf's aesthetic or mood over cosmetic word-choice concerns.
focus: Thematic alignment between elf aesthetic position, selected genre, and the tonal register of resulting name tokens
name: fd-aesthetic-name-coherence
persona: A narrative systems designer who evaluates whether procedural text output communicates underlying simulation state to the player.
review_areas: Audit genre family base-type tokens for tonal distinctiveness across families
Verify high-skill tiers feel qualitatively more advanced than low-skill tiers
Check 8 mood-ranged prefix pools map to clearly distinct emotional registers
Confirm is_night flag produces perceptibly different output
Audit suffix pools for inspiration-source coherence
success_hints: A player can identify genre family from the name alone
Each prefix pool has at least one unambiguous token
task_context: Procedural art naming system for elven colony sim: mood-ranged prefixes (8 pools), genre families (3: Classical/Anachronistic/Nature), skill-tiered base types (4 tiers), inspiration-source suffixes (5 pools).
